# LobsterAI **The open-source desktop AI agent that does real work on your computer.** Describe a task in plain language. LobsterAI reads your files, runs tools, drives a browser,
edits Office documents, and hands back finished work — at your desk or from your phone.

**English** · [简体中文](README_zh.md)

Download  ·  Quick start  ·  Features  ·  How it works  ·  Build & package  ·  Community

## Why LobsterAI Most AI assistants stop at an answer. LobsterAI is built to finish the job. - **It works where your work lives.** Point it at a folder and it reads spreadsheets, writes documents, runs scripts, and browses the web under configurable permission presets and interactive approvals. - **You see the result, not just a reply.** Web pages, charts, images, videos, PDFs, and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files open in a side panel, ready to edit live alongside the agent or share as a link. - **It keeps working when you step away.** Schedule recurring jobs with the built-in SQLite scheduler, or message your desktop agent from WeChat, WeCom, Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, QQ, Telegram, and Discord. - **Open, extensible, and yours.** MIT-licensed, powered by a bundled [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) runtime with local storage and disabled upstream telemetry. Sign in to use built-in models, bring your own API keys, or extend it with Kits, Skills, MCP servers, and DSH plugins. Built by [NetEase Youdao](https://www.youdao.com/), LobsterAI is the first open-source desktop-grade agent from a major Chinese tech company. ## Features

Native Office live editing
Open Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) right in the app. Edit by hand, or let the agent modify documents live alongside you.

Kits, skills, connectors & DSH plugins
Install role-based kits for engineering, design, finance, sales, and more; pick individual skills, connect OAuth MCP servers, or install DeepSeek Harness ecosystem plugins.

Scheduled tasks & remote IM control

Turn any prompt into a recurring job — morning briefs, end-of-day wrap-ups, weekly reports, and project health checks — with run history and automatic delivery to chat apps.

Connect WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, QQ, Telegram, or Discord once, then assign tasks to your desktop agent from your phone.
### Everything in the box | Capability | What you get | | --- | --- | | **Cowork sessions** | Long-running tasks on local projects with streaming progress, tool timelines, session forks, automatic context compaction, and configurable permission presets (`read-only`, `workspace-write`, full access) with interactive approvals. | | **Office & creative workflows** | Native in-app editing for `.docx`, `.xlsx`, and `.pptx` via live agent bridges, plus guided PPT creation, image generation and in-place editing, and Remotion video workflows. | | **Artifacts and sharing** | Live side-panel previews for HTML, SVG, Mermaid, images, video, Markdown, code, PDF, Office files, and local web services, with one-click link sharing. | | **Built-in browser & search** | An in-app browser the agent can drive, with tabs, saved logins, passkey (WebAuthn) support, visual annotations, and built-in web search. | | **Computer use** | Desktop GUI automation so the agent can operate native apps on Windows x64 and macOS 13 or later. | | **Multi-agent & delegation** | Create agents with independent personas, models, skills, and working directories; add ready-made experts from the Expert Plaza; spawn subagents or delegate across agents with visible subagent sessions in the sidebar; bind agents to IM channels. | | **Skills & Kits** | Role-based kits plus built-in skills for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, web search, Remotion video, frontend design, stock research, content writing, IMAP/SMTP email, Youdao Note, and more. See [`SKILLs/`](SKILLs). | | **DSH plugins & ecosystem** | Install, toggle, or remove DeepSeek Harness plugins from **Settings → Plugins** (using bundled `pnpm`), open the DSH Ecosystem View, use official bundles (AgentTeam, Worktree, LiveShare, DeepSeek Chat Import), and access the built-in `dsh` CLI shim. | | **MCP connectors** | Add local (`stdio`) or remote (`Streamable HTTP` / `SSE`) MCP servers from the marketplace, sign in with OAuth, and filter which tools each server exposes. | | **IM channels** | WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, QQ, Telegram, and Discord via LobsterAI's bundled DSH channels driver. Multi-instance platforms can route each bot to a different agent. | | **Scheduled tasks** | Built-in SQLite scheduler (`LobsterScheduler`) with templates, run logs, per-task working directories, and automatic IM result delivery. | | **Desktop companion & voice** | A floating orb for quick prompts, screenshots, and actions on selected text (translate, read aloud, and more), plus built-in voice input (ASR). | | **Memory** | Local Markdown workspace files (`AGENTS.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `SOUL.md`, `USER.md`, daily notes) carry preferences across sessions. Legacy Dreaming diaries remain readable in memory settings. | | **Models** | Built-in models (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM, MiniMax, and more) after sign-in, or bring your own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, OpenRouter, Doubao, Qianfan, StepFun, MiMo, Ollama, LM Studio, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. | | **Library** | Unified workspace view of every local artifact and shared file your agents generate across sessions. | ## Things to try | Scenario | Example prompt | | --- | --- | | Build a local tool | "I still track inventory and sales in Excel. Build a local inventory system that records purchases and sales, calculates stock and profit, and opens in my browser." | | Analyze local data | "Use `product-growth.xlsx` to build a visual dashboard and summarize the main growth drivers." | | Make a deck | "Research the AI agent market and turn the findings into a presentation." | | Check a web dashboard | "Open the ads dashboard every morning, check spend and conversion anomalies, and summarize likely causes." | | Screen documents | "Turn the resumes in this folder into a screening sheet and shortlist the strongest candidates against the JD." | | Run scheduled work | "Every weekday at 9 AM, collect yesterday's AI news and send me a concise digest." | ## Quick start 1. **Install LobsterAI.** Download it from the [official website](https://lobsterai.youdao.com/#/download-list), or get the latest release directly: [macOS (Apple Silicon)](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/releases/latest/download/LobsterAI--mac-arm64.dmg) · [macOS (Intel)](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/releases/latest/download/LobsterAI--mac-x64.dmg) · [Windows x64](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/releases/latest/download/LobsterAI--win-x64.exe) 2. **Choose a model.** Sign in to use the built-in models, or add your own API key under **Settings → Custom Model**. 3. **Give it a task.** Pick a working folder, choose a permission preset, describe what you want, and approve actions as it works. Generated files open in the side panel. 4. **Go further.** Install kits from **Kits · Skills · Connectors**, manage DSH plugins in **Settings → Plugins**, set up recurring work in **Scheduled Tasks**, or connect a chat app under **Settings → IM Bot**. > [!NOTE] > **Upgrading from legacy OpenClaw versions:** On first launch after upgrading, LobsterAI runs an offline atomic migrator before DSH starts. It snapshots `lobsterai.sqlite`, migrates your agent workspaces, memories, sessions, scheduled tasks, permissions, and MCP OAuth tokens, safely archives retired or incompatible modules under `userData/legacy-openclaw-backup/`, rolls back automatically on failure, and displays a migration summary. ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph App["LobsterAI desktop app (Electron)"] UI["Renderer
React · Redux · Tailwind
sessions · artifacts · Office editors"] Main["Main process
Cowork · SQLite · LobsterScheduler
MCP/OAuth · Built-in browser"] subgraph DshHost["Bundled DeepSeek Harness"] DSH["DSH Agent runtime"] HostBundle["@lobsterai/dsh-bundle
host tools · guards · bridges"] Channels["@lobsterai/dsh-channels
IM channel drivers"] end UI <-->|"preload IPC"| Main Main <-->|"session control · config · events"| DSH DSH <--> HostBundle Main <-->|"inbound · replies"| Channels end DSH --> Models["LLM providers"] HostBundle --> Tools["Files · shell · MCP · browser
Office · computer use · DSH plugins"] Chat["Chat apps
WeChat · WeCom · Feishu · DingTalk …"] <--> Channels ``` - **Cowork** is LobsterAI's desktop product layer. It owns sessions, messages, permission presets, artifacts, Office editor bridges, SQLite scheduling (`LobsterScheduler`), MCP OAuth, and IM bindings. - **[DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** runs the agent as an offline-complete bundled runtime (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`, pinned in [`package.json`](package.json)). LobsterAI layers two first-party Cordis bundles under [`dsh-bundles/`](dsh-bundles): - `lobsterai-host` (`@lobsterai/dsh-bundle`): model/web-search/MCP bridges, persona and workspace scoping, progressive tool disclosure, approval guards, multi-agent delegation, ops RPC, and privacy/telemetry disabling. - `lobsterai-channels` (`@lobsterai/dsh-channels`): native drivers for WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu/Lark, QQ, Telegram, and Discord. - The renderer is sandboxed with context isolation and talks to the main process only through the preload IPC bridge. ## Build and package ### Prerequisites - Node.js `>=24.15.0 <25` - npm `>=11.17.0 <12` - Git and `tar` - `better-sqlite3@13.0.3` ships prebuilt N-API binaries, so Windows builds do not require Visual Studio C++ Build Tools. ### Run from source ```bash git clone https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI.git cd LobsterAI npm install # First run: build the pinned DSH runtime for the current platform and start Electron npm run electron:dev:dsh # Daily development once vendor/dsh-runtime/current is prepared npm run electron:dev ``` Useful runtime options and checks: - `DSH_NPM_REGISTRY=` overrides the npm registry when fetching `@deepseek-ai/dsh`; `DSH_FORCE_BUILD=1` forces a runtime rebuild. - Verify the runtime and privacy guard after runtime or patch changes: `npm run dsh:runtime:verify` · `npm run dsh:upgrade-check` · `npm run dsh:e2e`. ### Package installers Build on a host matching the target operating system and architecture so native dependencies match. Outputs are written to `release/`. ```bash # Clean install and clear stale main-process build output npm ci npx rimraf dist dist-electron # Build the installer for your target npm run dist:mac:arm64 # macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg) npm run dist:mac:x64 # macOS Intel (.dmg) npm run dist:win # Windows x64 full offline NSIS installer (.exe) ``` Windows distribution variants (channel builds and CDN web installers): ```bash # Full offline installer tagged for a distribution channel npm run dist:win:channel -- --keyfrom [--silent] # Lightweight web installer stub that downloads the .nsis.7z app payload from your CDN npm run dist:win:web -- --keyfrom [--silent] [--pkg-base-url | --pkg-url ] ``` ### How the packaging pipeline works - **Self-contained DSH runtime:** `scripts/build-dsh-runtime.cjs` fetches the pinned `@deepseek-ai/dsh` npm package (no sibling source checkout required), installs platform/arch production dependencies plus a pinned `pnpm` (`package-manager/pnpm`) for end-user plugin installs, applies version-scoped patches from `scripts/dsh-patches//`, prunes redundant heavy native packages (`libreoffice-kit-*`, `sherpa-onnx-*`) that LobsterAI replaces natively, and caches the result under `vendor/dsh-runtime/` (reused automatically when target, versions, and patch hashes match). - **macOS (`.dmg`):** Ships `dsh-runtime/`, `dsh-bundles/`, `SKILLs/`, and optional `computer-use/` under `Contents/Resources/`. `afterPack` strips `node_modules/.bin` symlinks inside packaged DSH trees for codesign compatibility, and `dist:mac:arm64` runs `dsh:upgrade-check` before packaging. - **Windows (NSIS `.exe` & `nsis-web`):** Runs `predist:win` (`dsh:runtime:win-x64`), enforces the `verify:installer-patches` gate (`patches/app-builder-lib+*.patch`), builds `selection-hook`, prepares the embedded Windows Python 3.11 runtime (`setup:python-runtime`), and packs `dsh-runtime/`, `dsh-bundles/`, `SKILLs/`, and `python-win/` into a single `win-resources.tar` unpacked by `unpack-dsh-resources.cjs` during installation for faster installs. Run `npm run setup:mingit` if you also want bundled PortableGit for Git-sourced DSH plugin installs without system Git. - **Standalone runtime archives:** Maintain CDN-hosted runtime tarballs in `package.json` (`dsh.runtimes`) with `npm run dsh:runtime:pack`, `npm run dsh:runtime:url`, and `npm run dsh:runtime:verify-urls`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for offline/private-mirror environment variables, upgrading DSH versions, tests, linting, and the full project map. ## Security and privacy - **Local-first, isolated storage:** Desktop sessions, messages, scheduled tasks, and settings live locally in `lobsterai.sqlite`. Under the same user data directory, `dsh-profile/` holds LobsterAI's isolated DSH state and `workspaces//` holds agent instructions and memory — completely separate from any standalone DSH installation. - **Upstream telemetry disabled:** [`dsh-bundles/lobsterai-host/cordis.patch.yml`](dsh-bundles/lobsterai-host/cordis.patch.yml) explicitly disables upstream DSH telemetry and DeepSeek account plugins, verified automatically by `npm run dsh:upgrade-check`. - **Permission controls & sandboxing:** Tool actions follow each session's permission preset (`read-only`, `workspace-write`, or full access) and interactive approval prompts. Renderer windows run with context isolation, sandboxing, and no Node.js integration. ## Community Join the WeChat group for help, feedback, and release news. You can also follow [@LobsterAIYoudao](https://x.com/LobsterAIYoudao) on X. Report bugs and request features through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/issues/new/choose). ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) to set up your environment, and look for [good first issues](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22good%20first%20issue%22) to get started. ## Star history ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © NetEase Youdao

# LobsterAI **开源的桌面级 AI Agent，在你的电脑上把活真正干完。** 用一句话描述任务，LobsterAI 会读取文件、调用工具、操作浏览器、编辑 Office 文档，
最后把做好的成果交给你。坐在电脑前可以用，出门在外也能用手机远程指挥。

[English](README.md) · **简体中文**

下载  ·  快速上手  ·  功能  ·  工作原理  ·  构建与打包  ·  社区

## 为什么选择 LobsterAI 大多数 AI 助手只给你一个回答，LobsterAI 的目标是把事情做完。 - **直接在你的工作环境里干活。** 指定一个文件夹，它就能按你设置的权限预设和审批规则读表格、写文档、跑脚本、查网页。 - **给你看得见的成果，而不只是一段回复。** 网页、图表、图片、视频、PDF 以及 Word、Excel、PPT 文件都会在侧边栏打开，支持与 Agent 同步实时编辑或一键生成分享链接。 - **你离开时，它也在继续工作。** 通过内置 SQLite 调度器运行定时任务，或者通过微信、企业微信、飞书/Lark、钉钉、QQ、Telegram、Discord 给桌面上的 Agent 远程派活。 - **开源、可扩展且数据归你所有。** MIT 开源协议，内置 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 运行时，数据本地隔离存储且默认禁用上游遥测。登录即可使用内置模型，也可填入自己的 API Key，并通过套件、技能、MCP 连接器与 DSH 插件持续扩展。 LobsterAI 由[网易有道](https://www.youdao.com/)出品，是国内大厂首个开源的桌面级 Agent。 ## 功能

Office 原生实时编辑
Word（.docx）、Excel（.xlsx）、PPT（.pptx）直接在应用内打开。可以自己动手改，也可以让 Agent 和你同步实时协作编辑。

套件、技能、连接器与 DSH 插件
按岗位安装工程、设计、财务、销售等套件，按需挑选单个技能，接入支持 OAuth 的 MCP 服务，或安装 DeepSeek Harness 生态插件。

定时任务与多端 IM 远程派活

任何指令都能变成周期任务——科技早报、每日工作收尾、周报草稿、项目巡检——保留完整运行记录，并可将结果自动投递到聊天应用。

绑定一次微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书/Lark、QQ、Telegram 或 Discord，出门在外也能用手机直接给桌面 Agent 派活。
### 完整能力一览 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **Cowork 会话** | 围绕本地项目执行长任务，实时展示进度和工具调用过程，支持会话分叉、上下文自动压缩，以及可配置的会话权限预设（`read-only`、`workspace-write`、完全访问）与交互审批。 | | **Office 与内容创作** | 原生实时编辑 `.docx`、`.xlsx`、`.pptx` 并支持 Agent 同步修改；同时提供向导式 PPT 创作、图片生成与原地编辑、Remotion 视频创作流程。 | | **产物预览与分享** | 侧边栏实时预览 HTML、SVG、Mermaid、图片、视频、Markdown、代码、PDF、Office 文档与本地 Web 服务，支持一键生成分享链接。 | | **内置浏览器与联网搜索** | Agent 可直接操控的应用内浏览器，支持多标签页、保存登录状态、通行密钥（Passkey / WebAuthn）、页面批注，并内置联网搜索能力。 | | **电脑操控** | 桌面 GUI 自动化，让 Agent 操作原生桌面应用，支持 Windows x64 和 macOS 13 及以上版本。 | | **多 Agent 与子 Agent 委派** | 创建拥有独立人设、模型、技能和工作目录的 Agent；从专家广场添加现成专家；支持派生子 Agent 与跨 Agent 委派（侧边栏可查看子 Agent 会话）；支持按渠道绑定不同 Agent。 | | **技能与套件** | 提供岗位套件以及 Word、Excel、PPT、PDF、联网搜索、Remotion 视频、前端设计、股票研究、写作、IMAP/SMTP 邮件、有道云笔记等内置技能，详见 [`SKILLs/`](SKILLs)。 | | **DSH 插件与生态中心** | 在 **设置 → 插件** 中直接安装、启停或卸载 DeepSeek Harness 插件（由内置 `pnpm` 驱动），打开 DSH 生态视图，兼容官方实验能力（AgentTeam、Worktree、LiveShare、DeepSeek 对话导入）与内置 `dsh` CLI。 | | **MCP 连接器** | 从市场添加本地（`stdio`）或远程（`Streamable HTTP` / `SSE`）MCP 服务，支持 OAuth 登录，并可为每个服务单独筛选开放的工具。 | | **IM 渠道** | 通过 LobsterAI 内置的 DSH 渠道包支持微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书/Lark、QQ、Telegram 和 Discord；多实例平台可将不同机器人路由给不同 Agent（Telegram 和 Discord 在英文界面下显示）。 | | **定时任务** | 内置 SQLite 调度器（`LobsterScheduler`），提供开箱即用的任务模板、执行历史、独立工作目录，并支持将执行结果推送到 IM 渠道。 | | **桌面悬浮球与语音输入** | 桌面常驻悬浮球，支持快速发起任务、截图提问以及划词翻译/朗读等快捷操作，同时内置语音输入（ASR）。 | | **记忆** | Agent 通过本地 Markdown 工作区文件（`AGENTS.md`、`MEMORY.md`、`SOUL.md`、`USER.md` 及每日笔记）跨会话延续偏好；历史梦境日记可在记忆设置中查阅。 | | **模型** | 登录后可使用 DeepSeek、Kimi、通义千问、GLM、MiniMax 等内置模型；也可填入 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、xAI、OpenRouter、豆包、千帆、阶跃星辰、MiMo、Ollama、LM Studio 或任意 OpenAI 兼容接口的 API Key。 | | **我的文件** | 跨会话汇总所有 Agent 生成的本地产物与已分享文件，在一处统一检索与管理。 | ## 试试这些任务 | 场景 | 示例指令 | | --- | --- | | 本地工具 | "我还在用 Excel 记录库存和销售，帮我做一个本地进销存系统，可以录入进货和销售，自动计算库存和利润，并能在浏览器打开。" | | 数据分析 | "基于 `product-growth.xlsx` 做一个可视化看板，并总结主要增长原因。" | | 汇报 PPT | "调研 AI Agent 市场格局，并把结论整理成一份演示文稿。" | | 网页巡检 | "每天早上打开广告后台，检查消耗和转化是否异常，并总结可能原因。" | | 文档筛选 | "把这个文件夹里的简历整理成筛选表，对照 JD 选出最匹配的人。" | | 定时任务 | "每个工作日早上 9 点收集昨天的 AI 新闻，并发我一份简洁摘要。" | ## 快速上手 1. **安装 LobsterAI。** 从[官网](https://lobsterai.youdao.com/#/download-list)下载，或直接获取最新版本： [macOS（Apple 芯片）](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/releases/latest/download/LobsterAI--mac-arm64.dmg) · [macOS（Intel 芯片）](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/releases/latest/download/LobsterAI--mac-x64.dmg) · [Windows x64](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/releases/latest/download/LobsterAI--win-x64.exe) 2. **选择模型。** 登录后即可使用内置模型，也可以在 **设置 → 自定义模型** 中填入自己的 API Key。 3. **布置任务。** 选择工作目录与权限预设，描述你想要的结果，并在执行过程中审批关键操作。生成的文件会在侧边栏打开。 4. **更进一步。** 在 **套件·技能·连接器** 中安装套件，在 **设置 → 插件** 中管理 DSH 插件，在 **定时任务** 中设置周期任务，或在 **设置 → IM 机器人** 中绑定聊天应用。 > [!NOTE] > **从旧版 OpenClaw 升级：** 升级后首次启动时，LobsterAI 会在 DSH 启动前自动执行纯离线原子迁移：先对 `lobsterai.sqlite` 做快照备份，迁移原有 Agent 工作区、记忆、会话、定时任务、权限配置与 MCP OAuth 凭证，将已下线或不兼容模块安全归档到 `userData/legacy-openclaw-backup/`，异常时自动回滚，并在启动后展示迁移报告。 ## Office · 电脑操控 · DSH 插件"] Chat["聊天应用
微信 · 企微 · 飞书 · 钉钉 …"] <--> Channels ``` - **Cowork** 是 LobsterAI 的桌面产品层，负责会话、消息、权限预设、产物预览、Office 编辑器桥接、SQLite 定时调度（`LobsterScheduler`）、MCP OAuth 和 IM 绑定。 - **[DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** 以离线完整的内置运行时运行 Agent（`@deepseek-ai/dsh`，版本锁定在 [`package.json`](package.json)）。LobsterAI 在 [`dsh-bundles/`](dsh-bundles) 下叠加了两个自研 Cordis Bundle： - `lobsterai-host`（`@lobsterai/dsh-bundle`）：模型 / 联网搜索 / MCP 桥接、人设与记忆作用域隔离、渐进式工具披露、权限审批守卫、多 Agent 委派、运维 RPC 以及遥测禁用保护。 - `lobsterai-channels`（`@lobsterai/dsh-channels`）：微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书/Lark、QQ、Telegram、Discord 渠道驱动。 - 渲染进程启用了上下文隔离和沙箱，只能通过 preload IPC 桥与主进程通信。 ## 构建与打包 ### 环境要求 - Node.js `>=24.15.0 <25` - npm `>=11.17.0 <12` - Git 和 `tar` - `better-sqlite3@13.0.3` 已自带预编译 N-API 二进制文件，Windows 下安装与打包不需要 Visual Studio C++ Build Tools。 ### 本地源码运行 ```bash git clone https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI.git cd LobsterAI npm install # 首次运行：为当前平台构建锁定版本的 DSH 运行时并启动 Electron npm run electron:dev:dsh # vendor/dsh-runtime/current 准备好后，日常开发直接使用 npm run electron:dev ``` 常用运行时变量与检查： - 可用 `DSH_NPM_REGISTRY=<地址>` 覆盖拉取 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 的 npm registry，用 `DSH_FORCE_BUILD=1` 强制重建运行时。 - 调整运行时或补丁后，可依次执行验证： `npm run dsh:runtime:verify` · `npm run dsh:upgrade-check` · `npm run dsh:e2e`。 ### 打包安装程序 请在与目标操作系统和架构一致的机器上打包，确保原生依赖匹配；构建产物输出到 `release/`。 ```bash # 按 lock 文件干净安装依赖，并清理可能残留的主进程旧编译产物 npm ci npx rimraf dist dist-electron # 按目标平台选择打包命令 npm run dist:mac:arm64 # macOS Apple 芯片（.dmg） npm run dist:mac:x64 # macOS Intel 芯片（.dmg） npm run dist:win # Windows x64 完整离线 NSIS 安装包（.exe） ``` Windows 渠道包与在线安装器（基于同一条 `dist:win` 链路）： ```bash # 指定渠道的完整离线安装包 npm run dist:win:channel -- --keyfrom <渠道> [--silent] # 轻量在线安装器（stub，安装时从 CDN 下载 .nsis.7z 主包） npm run dist:win:web -- --keyfrom <渠道> [--silent] [--pkg-base-url | --pkg-url <主包地址>] ``` ### 打包方案说明 - **自包含 DSH 运行时：** `scripts/build-dsh-runtime.cjs` 直接拉取 `package.json` 锁定的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` npm 包（无需再维护同级源码仓库），按目标平台和架构安装生产依赖及锁定版本的 `pnpm`（`package-manager/pnpm`，供用户安装 DSH 插件），应用 `scripts/dsh-patches//` 下的版本化补丁，裁剪 LobsterAI 已原生替代的重型依赖（`libreoffice-kit-*`、`sherpa-onnx-*`），并缓存在 `vendor/dsh-runtime/`（目标、版本与补丁哈希一致时自动复用）。 - **macOS（`.dmg`）：** 将 `dsh-runtime/`、`dsh-bundles/`、`SKILLs/` 及可选的 `computer-use/` 打入 `Contents/Resources/`；`afterPack` 会清理运行时目录中的 `node_modules/.bin` 软链接以兼容代码签名，`dist:mac:arm64` 打包前还会自动执行 `dsh:upgrade-check`。 - **Windows（NSIS `.exe` 与 `nsis-web`）：** 先经 `predist:win` 构建 `win-x64` 运行时，执行 `verify:installer-patches` 门禁（校验 `patches/app-builder-lib+*.patch`），构建 `selection-hook` 与便携版 Windows Python 3.11 运行时（`setup:python-runtime`），再将 `dsh-runtime/`、`dsh-bundles/`、`SKILLs/`、`python-win/` 合并打包为单个 `win-resources.tar`，安装阶段由 `unpack-dsh-resources.cjs` 高速解压。如需在无系统 Git 的环境下支持 Git 源 DSH 插件安装，可额外准备便携 Git（`npm run setup:mingit`）。 - **独立运行时分发包：** 可通过 `npm run dsh:runtime:pack`、`npm run dsh:runtime:url` 和 `npm run dsh:runtime:verify-urls` 生成并登记 `package.json` 中的 `dsh.runtimes` CDN 分发包。 更多细节（离线/私有源环境变量、升级 DSH 版本、测试与 Lint、完整项目目录地图）请参阅 [CONTRIBUTING_zh.md](CONTRIBUTING_zh.md)。 ## 安全与隐私 - **本地优先、数据隔离：** 桌面会话、消息、定时任务与配置保存在应用数据目录的 `lobsterai.sqlite` 中；同目录下的 `dsh-profile/` 保存 LobsterAI 专用的 DSH 状态，`workspaces//` 保存 Agent 指令与记忆，与用户独立安装的 DSH 完全隔离。 - **默认禁用上游遥测：** [`dsh-bundles/lobsterai-host/cordis.patch.yml`](dsh-bundles/lobsterai-host/cordis.patch.yml) 显式禁用了所有上游 DSH 遥测与 DeepSeek 账号插件，并由 `npm run dsh:upgrade-check` 自动门禁校验。 - **权限控制与沙箱隔离：** 工具调用遵循会话权限预设（`read-only`、`workspace-write`、完全访问）及审批确认；渲染进程窗口启用上下文隔离和沙箱，并禁用 Node.js 集成。 ## 社区 扫码加入微信交流群，获取帮助、反馈问题、了解最新版本动态。也欢迎在 X 上关注 [@LobsterAIYoudao](https://x.com/LobsterAIYoudao)。 Bug 反馈和功能建议请通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/issues/new/choose) 提交。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎参与贡献。请先阅读 [CONTRIBUTING_zh.md](CONTRIBUTING_zh.md) 搭建开发环境，也可以从 [good first issue](https://github.com/netease-youdao/LobsterAI/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22good%20first%20issue%22) 开始上手。 ## Star 趋势 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) © 网易有道
